2ndxi.message:
What a performance today lads, 4 goals, clean sheet and controlled the game incredibly well. Congratulations! 

Enjoy your weekends, parents thank you for all your support! See you all next week at training 👏
2ndxi.author: Will Litchfield

2ndxi.message:
Hey everyone, 

Game info tomorrow, meet at selwyn changing rooms at 9:00am for a 10:00am ko. 

Huge game against Howick tomorrow, let’s give them a big fight and come away with the win 💪
2ndxi.author: Will Litchfield

2ndxi.message:
Hey guys, 

Because it suits most people, we will do a 2:30pm-3:45 training tomorrow.

See you all then.
2ndxi.author: Will Litchfield

2ndxi.message:
Hey everyone, 

With exams this week, I’m aware the latest exam finishes at 2pm? (Correct me if I’m wrong), would you guys want to do a 2:30pm training time start instead to make it easier for everyone? 

Thumbs up to this message if so!
2ndxi.author: Will Litchfield

2ndxi.message:
Hey guys just letting you know that I’ve decided to leave 2nd XI, good luck for the rest of the season

Thanks
2ndxi.author: Max J

2ndxi.message:
Hey guys, 

Does anyone have a pair of GK gloves they are able to bring to the game tomorrow? If you can, please let me know in the replies section to this message as soon as possible. 

Thanks!!
2ndxi.author: Will Litchfield

2ndxi.message: 2-0 Auckland FC thus far...;)
2ndxi.author: Jarrod King

2ndxi.message: For tomorrow’s game, can we confirmation on the timings please? TeamReach says 11.30am start but collegesport.co.nz says 10am 🤷🏻‍♂
2ndxi.author: Brian Lomas

2ndxi.message:
Hey everyone, 

Just some clarification around tomorrow’s game…

Meet at 9am at selwyn for a 10am ko. 

Let’s get our first three points tomorrow 💪
2ndxi.author: Will Litchfield

2ndxi.message: Back field today lads
2ndxi.author: Will Litchfield

2ndxi.message:
Hey guys, 

Hope you have all recovered well after the weekend. 

This week Mr Box will be recording some videos for his C licence with us, so if you could all update TeamReach as soon as possible, so he can plan the session, that would be greatly appreciated!

See you all on Thursday.
2ndxi.author: Will Litchfield

2ndxi.message: Could anyone please drop off Marvin and kase home after the game?
2ndxi.author: jo gosse

2ndxi.message:
Hey guys, game tomorrow is at St Kent’s away, field 1. 

Ko is 10am so try to be there for 9am to give us enough time to warm up + get ready before the game!

If you are not feeling 100% or are injured and cannot commit to a full game, personally I’d rather you rest up for next week than risk re-injury or prolonged sickness. We have plenty of players so please let me know if you aren’t going to make it. 

Cheers, hopefully we can grab our first 3 points of the year tomorrow!
2ndxi.author: Will Litchfield

Thanks, see you all there 💪
